read_data.description: Read a JSONL (or supported) file into the main record stream.

write_data.description: Write records to JSONL and pass the same stream through for downstream steps.

map_fields.description: Rename or remap field keys per record using a mapping table.

add_field.description: Add a new field to each record (constant, derived, or placeholder for instantiation).

remove_field.description: Remove one or more fields from each record.

merge_fields.description: Combine multiple fields into one target field with a join strategy.

split_field.description: Split one field into several new fields using delimiter or pattern rules.

transform_field.description: Deterministic transforms on a field (trim, casing, regex, type cast) — not LLM.

normalize_schema.description: Align records to a target schema: defaults, coercion, nested shape alignment.

combine_sources.description: Merge two record streams (join, concat, align) into one stream.

aggregate_group.description: Group records by keys and compute aggregates per group.

filter_rows.description: Keep or drop records matching a predicate over fields.

deduplicate.description: Remove duplicate records by key fields or full-row identity.

sample_rows.description: Take a fixed-size or ratio sample for trial runs or QA.

sort_rows.description: Order records by one or more keys with stable tie-breaking.

llm_generate_field.description: Generate a new field from context fields and a generation spec (answers, SQL, instructions, etc.).

llm_rewrite_field.description: Rewrite an existing field to a target style, template, length band, or format.

llm_extract_structure.description: Extract structured fields from unstructured text in a source field.

llm_expand_content.description: Expand short content into fuller, layered text while preserving intent.

validate_schema.description: Validate each record against required fields, types, and constraints; emit a structured report.

check_format.description: Check format patterns (tags, sections, regex) and emit a human-readable report.

llm_score_quality.description: LLM-based scoring of a field against a rubric (not a full rewrite).

llm_check_consistency.description: Check logical consistency across multiple fields; output issues in a report.

llm_verify_reasoning.description: Verify multi-step reasoning or derivation chains for internal soundness.

llm_verify_answer_grounding.description: Verify that an answer is grounded in given evidence or context fields.
